summary: Lead barista with over four years in high-volume specialty and campus cafés, running espresso bars through peak rushes of roughly 120 drinks an hour and around 600 transactions a day across multiple stations. Skilled in manual espresso dial-in, batch brew, milk texturing and latte art, with POS operation, opening and closing procedures, and inventory ordering. Has trained new staff and handled cash drawers and food-safety-compliant stations, operating as a shift lead in early-morning service.

facts.workAuthorization: Permanent resident (green card); no sponsorship needed
